toolchain.host: Windows 11 / Podman 6.1.4 / Debian bookworm container guix-work
toolchain.buildAdjustment: em-pb/Mf-config exeSuffix changed from .html to .js to avoid Emscripten 3.1.6 htmlmin failure; the Wasm/JS/data assets themselves were produced by the official target

fixed-aot.reason: The official Emscripten target is a portable-bytecode VM, not a native Wasm code generator.

pure-dynamic.smoke: 3/3 minimum operations passed: eval, dynamic registration plus call, isolated eval
pure-dynamic.corpus: 16/31 fixtures passed; failures are missing plugin library forms, JSON null representation, error-code mapping, capture/atomicity gaps, and source-order behavior

async-ffi.reason: No async FFI mechanism was exercised.

protocol.hostToGuest: the host prepends a Scheme datum to guest.scm; this is not a strict JSON parser inside the guest
protocol.guestToHost: guest emits one JSON object per line
protocol.note: The minimum operations pass, but transport conformance is weaker than Hoot/Chibi and must be counted against Chez in the decision.

isolation.process: each invocation runs run.cjs in a child process
isolation.statePersistence: one child process per request; cross-request state is not provided

decision: Chez clears the dynamic eval/register minimum and has a small Wasm asset footprint, but its R6RS-oriented runtime, non-JSON guest transport, and boot/VM complexity make it a conditional candidate rather than the preferred one.
